tagline: A 32-HP juggernaut that pays in blood to drag you close and pin you there

featuredCards.title: Crash through the Trees
featuredCards.caption: Kong walks straight through anyone in the way. Getting into your zone is never the hard part of this deck.

featuredCards.title: reCKLESS LUNGE
featuredCards.caption: Three damage, three taken. With 32 health, his own bar is just another resource to spend.

featuredCards.title: Smash and grab
featuredCards.caption: Wins the combat, then plants you wherever he likes with no movement next turn. This is the lockdown.

featuredCards.title: eighth wonder of the world
featuredCards.caption: An 8 for the price of standing still and bleeding. The turn ends here, and so does most of your plan.
